estimateContract.budget: ProviderSourceEnforcer uses nonzero production estimates to choose send, density and compression across the threshold. Public HTTP is a large-budget send, not a complete small-budget automatic-compression round trip.
estimateContract.differenceFromOldPrompt: Per-unit estimates are approximate; exact concatenated-prompt tokenizer boundaries are not promised. Differential bounds are unchanged. No byte fixture or old-converter assertion was weakened.
